column1: *** PEDRO ANTONIO DE LA SANTISIMA TRINIDAD ***
column3: *** 'El Capellan del Regimiento de Infanteria de Buenos Ayres Don Bartolome Munoz bautizo, puso oleo y crisma a Pedro Antonio de la SS.ma Trinidad, que nacio ayer, hijo legitimo del Soldado Dragon Sancho Llerena y de Maria Fernandez. Fueron padrinos Don Antonio Aleman y su mujer.' *** Margin: 'Pedro Antonio Llerena'. *** In 1826 a record calls him 'Mayor Don Pedro Antonio Llerena'. ***
Godfather *** Don Fidel Rey *** - which is where the next child's name comes from.

column3: Named for his sister's godfather. *** A Fidel Lerena married Maria Ruedas in the Montevideo branch this archive reached through Victor Lerena, and whether that is this Fidel is NOT established. ***

Married *** Manuel Zeferino Barros, natural de Pernambuco ***, at the Cordon, *** 3 November 1830 *** - 'hija legitima de Sancho Llerena y de Maria Fernandez'. Her children include Francisco Juan Ramon (1826) and Lucinda Gregoria (1827) - *** both born BEFORE the marriage act, which this archive has already noted and not smoothed. ***

*** 'bautizo... a una parvula de dos dias nacida, a la cual puso por nombre Dominga Josefa, hija legitima de Sancho Llerena y de Maria Fernandez; fueron los Padrinos Joseph Ponteceli y Agueda Rivero.' *** Married *** Capitan Don Antonio Ruiz (or Rodriguez) de Carvallo *** - the two acts spell him differently and *** FamilySearch's own index splits the same way, which argues the difference is in the registers. ***
Found only by the variant sweep on *** 'Sancho Lorena' ***. Never followed past his own baptism.

column2: born 9 February 1811; baptised 10 February 1811, Iglesia Matriz, Montevideo
column3: *** 'bautice solemnemente a Luis Escolastico que nacio ayer, hijo legitimo de Don Sancho Llerena natural de Andalucia y de Dona Maria Fernandez natural de Asturias. Abuelos paternos Feliz Gerena y Rosalia Aguilar, idem maternos Rodrigo Fernandez y Rosa Fernandez.' *** *** The single most valuable act in this archive after the 1791 marriage. ***

Married *** Ambrosia Traibel *** before May 1843 - the Lerena Traibel branch. *** A separate index cluster gives an 'Avelino Eduardo Lerena' married to CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS with children surnamed LERENA VILLADEMOROS. Whether that is a second marriage or a son is not established. ***
column4: PRIMARY for the death; SECONDARY for Villademoros

column3: *** The padron of 1812 returns SIX children in the household ***, when eight are now named across the registers. *** The four born after 1806 - Luis (1811) and Avelino (1815) - cannot both be in a household return of 1812, and Avelino certainly is not. *** So six in 1812 is consistent with eight over the whole marriage, *** and it means one or more of the earlier children had died before 1812. *** This archive has already reasoned that way once, about a boy of about five missing from the same return.
